policy.ingestion: none — this audit does not fetch, ingest, impute or modify observations
policy.descriptive_vs_formal: descriptive_coverage is everything currently stored for a series; formal_model_samples are the frozen estimation windows read from the model registries. A descriptive backfill must never widen a formal sample.
policy.historical_data_gate: Do not ingest historical data until this report is reviewed by the owner.
policy.missing_values: Missing values stay null; they are never converted to 0 or interpolated.
policy.fingerprint: sha256 over 'period=value' lines inside the audited window; any replacement, deletion or zero-fill inside the window changes it, while earlier backfill and later months do not.

feasibility_categories.safe_descriptive_backfill: archived official extract + cleared definition-compatible floor; all pre-window values are after the floor
feasibility_categories.safe_descriptive_backfill_with_review_se: safe from the cleared floor; values before the floor need methodological review
feasibility_categories.likely_safe_pending_retrieval: same official table/definition as current records; source query still required
feasibility_categories.derived_after_level_backfill: computed series; recompute after the level backfill
feasibility_categories.requires_methodological_review: definition break, regime change, blocked v1.83 audit status, or series is a formal estimation frame
feasibility_categories.ingested_descriptive_history: Phase G descriptive history store; reproducible from archived official extracts, not a model input
feasibility_categories.requires_source_query: official table identified but its start date for this country is unknown until queried
